item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang las lam gyi rgyun khyer rnam gsum
item.coloph: gang zag lam gyi rgyun khyer rnam gsum zhes/ me ston drung mu zil gnon bzhed pa yis/ rang lo nyer dgu'i dus su bris pa la/ nang dang gsang ba'i snying po'i 'bru don ni/ dam tshig gsang ba'i gnad kyis ma bstan pa/ don gcig lon dus sgom sgrub mthar phyin skabs/ rten 'brel brda tsam bris pa'i dge ba des/ mtha' yas 'gro rnams srid pa'i mtsho bsgral nas/ mngon byang bde chen mchog gi sku thob shog/

item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang las lam gyi rgyun khyer rnam gsum
item.coloph: 'chi med rig 'dzin dran pa nam mkha' yi/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / khyad par bla med yang gsang rgyud mchog gi gang zag lam gyi rgyun khyer rnam gsum zhes/ me ston drung mu zil gnon bzhed pa yis/ rang lo nyer dgu dus su bris pa la/ nang dang gsang ba'i snying po'i 'bru don ni/ dam tshig gsang ba'i gnad kyis ma bstan na/ don gcig lon dus sgom sgrab mthar phyin skabs/ rten 'brel brda' tsam bris pa'i dge ba des/ mtha' yas 'gro rnams srid pa'i mtsho sgrol nas/ mngon byang bde chen mchog gi sku thob shog/
